reasoning.description: One or two sentences: what you have, what is missing, and what to do next.

agents.description: Agents to run in this round. When stop is true, exactly one: the synthesizer.

goal.description: What this agent should retrieve or answer.

stop.description: True only in the final round, when the synthesizer runs.

deliverable.description: What the user gets back. screen unless they asked for a PDF/document (pdf) or to have it emailed (email).
